text.text_excerpt: Basic convenience store that serves hot plates. Chicken wings - so crispy. so greasy. so perfect. I honestly don't think anyone can really f up chicken wings. Spicy fried rice - wowza! This can get your mouth tingling. It has so much more flavor than the regular fried rice. So if you can handle a bit of heat, make it hot! Fries - I would say you can't f up fries. But they can and they did. It was over fried and super hard. Probably fresh from the freezer fries. Hot sausage on toast with egg and cheese, fully dressed - omgggg. I love this. It's so good. Today they forgot my cheese and my egg wasn't over easy, so it wasn't as much of a guilty pleasure as I was hoping, but still good enough ...

Went to Matt's while visiting family in the area. The guy who rung the order was surprisingly polite and my fish po-boys and fried chicken plate was good and tasty. I also like that they sell The Hot Mama Pickles, and other stacks that are hard to find. The surrounding area is not the safest feeling, and I would use caution tracking to this location if you go in the evening. But for a decent sandwich and fried chicken give them a try.

Forget Manchu..... This place is winning if ur looking for some good fried rice and chicken wings!!!! Area isn't so pretty and it's a convenient store but don't let that shit fool u.... Quick food. On the go food. Don't feel like cooking and ur home alone food. Fat girl Fat boy moment food!!!! Idea gotten. Basically food is delish.
